## Mathematical premises made explicit

The fixed linear residual expansion is valid with pointwise
D_k(m)=B_k(m)-A_k(Pi_k(m)). Using D_k as a linear model response or in the exact
joint matrix covariance additionally requires a fixed joint linear relation.
Mapping signatures alone do not establish that relation. Coefficient
recomputation alone neither proves nor disproves complete operator linearity;
the full application, centering, support and state must justify the claim.

Zero-model cancellation requires zero removal and rejoin contributions.
Identity-processing cancellation requires compatible domains, maps and support.
The model-mismatch prediction identifies the D_k-weighted contribution to bias,
not all sky bias. Derivative failures at selection/support/branch changes are
typed explicitly. These are logical premises for conditional statements, not
new numerical scientific-method decisions or defaults.
